payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods and annotations used to identify non-standard pronunciation, including the transcription of mispronunciations and disfluencies.

claims.text: Non-standard pronunciation is identified through annotations of mispronunciations, poor intelligibility, and hesitations in transcriptions.
The transcription includes labels for foreign words and non-verbal articulations, which helps in identifying non-standard pronunciations.
The study of historical language change and orthography normalization can aid in identifying non-standard pronunciations.
